description: This file defines a template class 'IteratorType' within the WPEFramework::RPC namespace. The class provides an iterator implementation for a container, supporting various initialization methods, navigation, and manipulation of elements. It is designed to be used as a base for creating specific iterator types that conform to an INTERFACE.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: A template class implementing an iterator over a container, supporting navigation, reset, and element addition, designed to be inherited by specific iterator implementations.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Pure virtual method for reference counting increment.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Pure virtual method for reference counting decrement.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the container.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element pointed to by the iterator.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element to the container.
